'''Justin Abdallah DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Justin Abdallah]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-16294">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16294 DeckTech post 16294], DeckTech (Justin "Lestat2150" Abdallah, 29 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16294/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16294/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Justin Abdallah]]
* '''Published:''' 29 May 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Desert Landing Site|Tat-D-tatooinedesertlandingsite.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat DLS Abdallah DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Using the new stradegy of capturing the queen from tattooine is what i'm trying to use.  Even though the set doesnt come out for another week i just cant hold it, i think this deck is very powerful.

== Original post ==

'''HOW DO YOU LOSE A 6 BICH'''
* '''Author:''' Justin "Lestat2150" Abdallah
* '''Published:''' May 29, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 1.5
* '''Description:''' Using the new stradegy of capturing the queen from tattooine is what i'm trying to use.  Even though the set doesnt come out for another week i just cant hold it, i think this deck is very powerful.

=== Strategy ===

Ok, i know what you guys are thinking, most of this deck isnt released yet.  This is how i think the deck should go.  ANyway, you start with the coolest tat site out right now and you'll probably get maul in your opening hand if not within your first draw phase.  If your opponent is playing podracing this is perfect.  Mostly everyone will put padme in their deck to start off.  If they dont then the drains are still decent.  The medium destiny in here is 3-5 which is bad for dueling. Ground power isnt a problem and space isnt that bad either.  I dont know what the sith probe droids do but they must help this deck theme some. I hope you enjoy this pre release title.
